note: Cross-rail authorization parity: the Python scope rail (kubona/security/policy.py) and the Go enforcement rail (tenant autonomy, admission, tool registry) must return the SAME verdict for the same abstract case. Each engine binds abstract principals/actions to its native constructs (documented in the respective test); the verdicts must agree. Cases marked go-only name a concept Python cannot express — a logged gap, not parity.

cases.why: unmapped actions refuse on both rails
principals with no scopes/rights are denied everything
read-only observation is the baseline grant
metered actions need an approval artifact on both rails
approval artifact admits the metered action
Go-only: Python has no tenant autonomy states (L0/suspended). Suspended status additionally has no mutator anywhere — dead state, logged as gap.
